user_query: I'm developing a language learning app and I need a text-to-speech system that can generate audio for multiple languages and accents. Can you provide me with a list of available speakers? Additionally, I would like to use an AI-powered chat detector to filter out any inappropriate or offensive content in the app.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of available text-to-speech speakers that support multiple languages and accents.
Integrate a chat detection system that uses AI to identify and filter out inappropriate or offensive content.
